index.heading: Front matter — page purpose
index.summary: KB page documenting the wire/message formats the Merchant Routing Service uses per brand. Reference material, not a change request.

index.heading: Message format
index.summary: CURRENT STATE: Mastercard uses ISO 8583 (1987) with brand-specific field 48 usage; Discover uses its own field layout. Field-level mappings live in the format registry.

index.heading: Brand rules
index.summary: Each brand imposes operational rules on the message contract — mandatory fields, allowed values, certification constraints — enforced by the format layer before dispatch.
